## 🎬 Two video creation modes: Model Engine vs Code Engine **One stickman director, two ways to create your visuals**: A uses video models to generate continuous shots; B uses code to animate layered assets. With the right tools, an AI agent can take either approach through to a finished video, following the selected style’s specifications.
A · Model Engine
B · Code Engine

You can also use this skill with other agents that can read and write files and run commands. Results may vary with the model’s capabilities, tool setup, and execution approach. ### Step 1: Install the skill On first use, your agent will check the required setup and help you install or configure anything missing. Send the following to your AI agent: ```text Help me install this skill: https://github.com/kaomei/stickman-video-director After installation, read SKILL.md and tell me you’re ready. ``` If you prefer the terminal or the installation times out, you can refer to the [manual installation guide](skills/directing-stickman-videos/references/installation-troubleshooting.md). ### Step 2: Choose a style and mode, then start with a prompt Choose a style you like from [Model Engine (A)](#a-styles) or [Code Engine (B)](#b-styles), then copy the corresponding prompt below, adapt it to your needs, and send it to your AI agent: ### A · Model Engine ```text Use Model Engine (A) to turn the following topic or text into a stickman video: [Enter a topic, paste your text, or describe your idea] Requirements: 16:9 landscape, style A3 “Prehistoric Cave.” Start with a 30-second video. First, give me a story outline, an audio plan, and a storyboard. After I approve them, provide self-contained video generation prompts for each scene. ``` - **Production workflow:** After approving the storyboard, you can generate the clips manually or ask your agent to generate them using its browser tools. Start with a low-resolution test. Once you approve the result, your agent can handle the remaining clips and assemble the full video, adding captions and audio as needed. A generated clip is source footage, not necessarily one finished shot. Choose its length to suit the story and the model’s capabilities, then trim, split, and combine clips in the edit. - **Recommended platform:** Use Google Flow to get closer to the sample results. For your first video, see the [detailed tutorial on X](https://x.com/AveryRunsAI/status/2124444676937621723?a=ONRkcoLggSVni_b78rQ&s=20). ### B · Code Engine ```text Use Code Engine (B) to turn the following topic or article into an engaging stickman video: [Paste an article, a news story, or a link, or describe your topic] Requirements: 16:9 landscape, 8 minutes, style B1 “Minimal Line Art,” with voiceover, captions, and sound effects. First, check that the local tools for image generation and rendering are set up. Then provide a complete script and a preview of the opening 20 seconds with audio. After I approve both, automatically prepare all assets, write the code, and render the complete video locally. ``` - **Production workflow:** After you approve the script and the preview of the opening 20 seconds with audio, the agent prepares the assets, animation, captions, and audio to match the selected style, then renders the full video locally and provides a preview. - **Targeted edits:** If you’re unhappy with part of the visuals or audio, ask your agent to adjust just that section while keeping the approved parts. ### Step 3: Create a thumbnail, title, and description Once you’re happy with the finished video, continue with the [Thumbnail & Publishing Kit](#thumbnail-publishing-kit). Download the cover and copy the text into YouTube Studio or TikTok as appropriate; nothing is uploaded or published automatically.* ## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions ### Q1. Is this really 100% free? Are there any hidden fees? Yes, the Skill itself is free: it's open-source under the MIT license, for personal and commercial projects, with zero subscription fees—unlike SaaS tools that charge $30–$60/month. There are no hidden fees, but the services you connect have their own costs: your AI agent's plan (such as Codex or Claude Code), third-party API usage for images or voice (such as Google Gemini or ElevenLabs), and, in Model Engine (A), video generation credits on platforms such as Google Flow. ### Q2. How do I maintain character consistency? **B · Code Engine**: Uses a code-driven production workflow. Character image assets are created before the video is produced and reused across scenes, so character consistency is relatively stable. **A · Model Engine**: Primarily relies on text-to-video generation. If a character has a complex hairstyle, outfit, or other features that are difficult to reproduce consistently from text alone, add a stick-figure character reference image and keep using it for subsequent clips to make the results more consistent. ### Q3. What tools do you recommend? Do I need a specific image generation model? For results closest to the demos, **use Google Flow to generate clips in Model Engine (A) and Codex to produce the full video in Code Engine (B).** All Code Engine demos were made with Codex. Describe what you want in plain language, and the agent writes the code and renders the video locally. **You can choose your own image generation model.** The Code Engine demos used Codex’s built-in image generation tool for visual assets, so that setup needs no separate image generation API. You can also use Claude Code or another agent that can read and write files and run terminal commands, together with your choice of image generation and voiceover tools. Start with a short sample with audio to check the style, captions, and sound before producing the full video. ### Q4. Can I make a video without an existing script? Yes. You can paste a rough idea, a shower thought, a news link, or an entire blog post. The AI director will extract the core conflict, write a compelling 3-second hook, and structure the story and shots to fit your topic, target length, and chosen style, complete with comedic timing and voiceover cues. ### Q5. How does the AI ensure the video has high viewer retention and isn't boring? Traditional AI tools just spit out literal illustrations of text. Stickman Video Director applies real **visual storytelling psychology**: - **The 3-Second Hook**: Transforms your opening sentence into an immediate visual contradiction or curiosity gap to stop viewers from scrolling away. - **Visual Metaphors**: Converts abstract, boring concepts into comedic visual jokes (e.g., anxiety depicted as a shrinking hamster wheel, burnout as a 1% battery bar). - **Pacing & Comic Pauses**: Inserts structured pauses, reaction shots, and sound effect cues (SFX) to mirror the comedic timing of creators like Casually Explained. ### Q6. Can I monetize these videos on YouTube and TikTok? Yes, the videos are yours to publish and monetize. Each video gets its own script, pacing and visual staging instead of reused footage, which is what YouTube's reused-content policy targets. Approval for the YouTube Partner Program (YPP) or the TikTok Creator Rewards Program is still decided by each platform, based on your channel as a whole: add your own ideas and voice, publish consistently, and follow each platform's rules on AI-generated content. ### Q7. Do I need programming skills or an expensive GPU? You don’t need to write code yourself or buy a high-end GPU. In Model Engine (A), clips are generated on online video platforms; in Code Engine (B), your agent writes the code and renders locally. ## 🎬 两种视频制作模式：Model Engine vs Code Engine **同一个火柴人导演，两种画面制作路线**：A 模式用视频模型生成连贯镜头，B 模式用代码驱动素材做分层动画。两者均支持 Agent 全自动制作到成片，并严格按对应画风的规范交付。
A · Model Engine (模型引擎)
B · Code Engine (代码引擎)
原理 把分镜提示词输入视频生成模型，直接生成连续动态画面。 AI 生成角色与场景分层底图，再用代码组装、运镜并本地渲染。
特点 动作流畅自然、光影质感足，画面生动，富有影视动态张力。 角色形象稳定，素材可复用，时间线节奏、排版位置和局部微调更易把控。
适合 拥有可用视频模型资源（如 Google Flow、优惠 API 或本地部署模型），主做高视觉表现力短视频的创作者。 已订阅 Codex / Claude Code 等编程会员（额度经常用不完），不想再额外掏钱买昂贵视频模型额度的用户。
使用 确认脚本和画风后获取分镜与提示词，直接手动出片；也能让 AI 在内置浏览器操作生成片段，并完成剪辑、字幕和声音制作。 按所选画风确认视频脚本与 20s 样片后，由 AI 自动完成所有素材准备、代码编写、动画驱动、字幕与声音制作，再在本地渲染。
产出 分镜脚本 + 逐段提示词 +（完整视频文件） 分层素材库（角色/场景/道具）+ 完整视频文件
成本 消耗第三方视频模型额度/积分，长视频制作成本与抽卡风险较高。 本地代码渲染无需视频模型额度；仅使用现成 Agent 额度与基础生图/配音。
给一个想法、一篇文章、网页链接或完整脚本，即可开始制作。两种模式均支持短视频与长篇内容，可按发布平台选择 `16:9` 横屏或 `9:16` 竖屏，并按需求与画风标准配置字幕、旁白配音、背景音乐和音效。 还没决定用哪种画风？下方分别提供不同画风的详细介绍和适用题材，以及更多样片供你参考。 #### API 合作伙伴 · [支持本项目 ↗](https://telegram.me/CrazyKaomei)
